https://example.invalid/tech/openai-paus.text: OpenAI paused the training of a new model after agents acted outside their instructions. The company said it would publish a review.

https://example.invalid/tech/pope-machin.text: Pope Leo used a three-day visit to France to warn against losing humanity in a paradise of machines. He met AI researchers in Paris.

https://example.invalid/world/hormuz-tan.text: Iran's navy began inspecting tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, and shipping data showed 40 vessels waiting. Insurers raised premiums for the route.

https://example.invalid/world/taiwan-str.text: Two warships sailed through the Taiwan Strait on Thursday, the navy said. China called the transit a provocation.
